name: SimRank and General Vertex-to-Vertex Structural Similarity
problem_statement: Compute a pairwise structural similarity score between vertices based on the recursive principle that two vertices are similar to the extent their in-neighbors (or neighbors) are similar, for a single source vertex, a query pair, or top-k over all vertices.

normalization: Preserve direction when similarity is defined over in-neighbors; project to undirected when undirected_projection is requested.
Collapse parallel edges to a single edge.

problem_inputs.name: query_mode
problem_inputs.description: Score one specific pair, one vertex against every other vertex, or the highest-similarity pairs/vertices overall.

problem_inputs.name: source_vertex
problem_inputs.description: Required for single_source_all; the fixed vertex in single_pair's pair.

problem_inputs.name: decay_factor
problem_inputs.description: SimRank decay constant C controlling how quickly similarity attenuates with path length.

problem_inputs.name: direction_mode
problem_inputs.description: Whether similarity propagates over in-neighbors (classic SimRank) or an undirected projection.

problem_inputs.name: top_k
problem_inputs.description: Result size limit for single_source_all or top_k_pairs.

problem_inputs.name: solution_quality
problem_inputs.description: Whether a sampling-based or truncated-iteration approximation with a disclosed error bound is permitted; exact fixed-point computation is expensive beyond small graphs.

problem_inputs.name: convergence_tolerance
problem_inputs.description: Maximum per-pair residual for declaring convergence in exact mode.

required_outputs.name: similarity_scores
required_outputs.description: Vertex pair and similarity score in [0,1], sized and ordered per query_mode.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether every eligible pair/vertex was scored and output was not truncated beyond top_k.

optional_outputs.name: converged
optional_outputs.description: Whether the iterative computation met convergence_tolerance.

optional_outputs.name: iterations
optional_outputs.description: Fixed-point iterations or sampled random walks performed.

optional_outputs.name: error_bound
optional_outputs.description: Disclosed bound on approximation error for approximate mode.

solution_semantics.objective: Compute the SimRank fixed point sim(a,b) = (decay_factor / (|In(a)||In(b)|)) * sum over in-neighbor pairs of sim(i,j), with sim(a,a) = 1 for every vertex a, under direction_mode.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact mode requires every reported score within convergence_tolerance of the fixed point; approximate mode must disclose error_bound.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each unordered vertex pair is scored once; sim(a,b) == sim(b,a).
solution_semantics.ordering: single_source_all and top_k_pairs are ordered by descending score with a stable vertex-ID tie break; single_pair returns one score.

validation_rules: sim(v,v) == 1 for every scored vertex v.
Scores are symmetric: sim(a,b) reported equals sim(b,a) if both are queried.
Recomputing scores via direct fixed-point iteration on small fixtures matches reported values within tolerance.
edge_cases: A vertex with no in-neighbors has similarity zero to every other vertex except itself.
Two vertices with identical in-neighbor sets converge toward similarity close to 1 as iterations increase.
Disconnected components yield similarity zero across components (other than self-similarity).
decay_factor near zero makes all off-diagonal similarities near zero; near one slows convergence sharply.

correctness: score error versus an exact fixed-point oracle on small/medium fixtures
